Moon Dregs — Innate Technique (11th level)

At 11th level, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to Moon Dregs’ AC as well as its Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution scores. Moon Dregs now makes three attacks when it takes the Attack action.

jjk5e.automationNotes: Edit the Moon Dregs actor: +CE mod to AC, STR, DEX, CON; 3 attacks.
